name: Dxcap.exe
description: DirectX diagnostics/debugger included with Visual Studio.
author: Oddvar Moe

commands.description: Launch specified executable as a subprocess of dxcap.exe. Note that you should have write permissions in the current working directory for the command to succeed; alternatively, add '-file c:\path\to\writable\location.ext' as first argument.
commands.usecase: Local execution of a process as a subprocess of dxcap.exe
